verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to operate Paychex Flex itself (running payroll, updating records, approving requests) through natural-language commands. The AI-powered compliance support answers questions and generates HR documents, and AI-suggested punch modifications are a separate assistive feature; both are adjacent capabilities, not natural-language control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
